title: VirtualBox virtual machines
whyItMatters: A virtual machine folder contains a whole second computer: settings, virtual disks and snapshots. It can hold data no other rule will see.
source: Oracle VirtualBox User Guide, default machine folder $HOME/VirtualBox VMs - https://www.virtualbox.org/manual/ch10.html
notes: Default machine folder only. Unconfirmed: a custom Default Machine Folder changed in VirtualBox preferences is not matched. Virtual disks are counted by size, never opened.
